# chatw - End-to-End Encrypted Private Messenger

> chatw is a minimalist, high-performance personal messaging application built with Rust (Axum) and SolidJS, featuring true zero-knowledge End-to-End Encryption (E2EE).

## Architecture & Cryptography
- Key Exchange: ECDH P-256 (NIST P-256) via Web Crypto API
- Key Derivation: HKDF-SHA-256
- Message Encryption: AES-256-GCM (12-byte IV, 16-byte authentication tag)
- Digital Signatures: ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256
- Local Key Storage: IndexedDB (non-extractable private keys)
- Real-time Transport: WebSocket with heartbeat and automatic reconnect
- Avatar Format: High-performance auto-compressed AVIF images

## Source Code & Deployment
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/kiyogo/chart
- Backend: Rust 1.85+, Axum 0.8, SQLx, PostgreSQL 16
- Frontend: SolidJS, TypeScript, Vite, Pure CSS (zero-dependency)
